feature.label: Constraint and Linear Solvers
feature.description:
Adds the types and operators needed to declare decision variables in GAML, state the constraints over them, and let a solver find an assignment that satisfies them, or the best one according to an objective.
Two families of solver sit behind the same syntax, chosen by a word when the problem is created. Constraint programming, through Choco-solver, handles combinatorial structure: all_different, sequencing, routing, and integer arithmetic that is not linear. Linear and mixed integer programming, through HiGHS, which ships with this plugin as a native binary, handles models made of weighted sums and bounds. A model moves from one to the other without being rewritten, and what a solver cannot express it refuses when the constraint is written rather than solving something else.
